title: Hamiltonian Expression
description: Essential Criteria - The Hamiltonian must be correctly written for all times, including the Heaviside step function.

title: Eigenstate Relation
description: Important Criteria - The relationship between eigenstates before and after the field introduction must be clearly established.

title: Probability Calculation
description: Essential Criteria - The probability of being in an excited state must be accurately derived and expressed.

title: Perturbation Theory Application
description: Important Criteria - The application of time-dependent perturbation theory must be correctly executed for the general electric field.

title: Final Probability Expression
description: Essential Criteria - The final expression for the probability in terms of the specific electric field must be correctly derived.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria - Missing the Heaviside function or making sign errors in the Hamiltonian will lead to significant deductions.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria - Units in the final expressions should be checked for consistency throughout the solution.

title: Limiting Cases
description: Optional Criteria - Discussion of limiting cases or special scenarios should be included for completeness.
